mainRepository.heading: Main repository
mainRepository.about: The main repository is where this workspace keeps .oxagen/ — its published steering records, the promotion ledger, and every agent definition. A workspace has one, and until it is bound the workspace is provisional: runs are still recorded and spend still counts, but steering and agent definitions stay off.
mainRepository.connected: Returned from GitHub. The installation is attached to this workspace.
mainRepository.installRefused: Returned from GitHub, but that installation could not be verified, so nothing was attached. Install the App again from this workspace and approve it on the account that owns the repository.

install.heading: Oxagen reaches a repository through its GitHub App
install.body: No installation is attached to this workspace yet, so there is nothing to pick from. Install the App on the account that owns the repository, or connect an installation that account already has; GitHub sends you back here either way.

mainRepository.unconfigured: This deployment has no GitHub App configured, so the App cannot be installed from here. An operator sets the App up before a repository can be bound.

picker.heading: Pick this workspace's main repository
picker.loading: Listing the repositories the installation reaches…
picker.empty: The installation reaches no repositories. Grant it access to one on GitHub, then reopen this panel.
picker.truncated: The installation reaches more repositories than this list holds, so the one you want may not be here. Narrow the App's repository access on GitHub and reopen this panel.

bound.heading: Bound
bound.retired: The GitHub connection this repository was bound through has been removed, so Oxagen can no longer read .oxagen/ from it: steering and Context PRs are off until it is bound again. The repository itself has not changed, and neither has anything else about this workspace — it has to be bound again through a live GitHub connection.
bound.fixed: Which repository is main cannot be changed here. Moving a workspace to another repository is an org owner's decision and is recorded as a security event, so it is done with the people accountable for this workspace rather than from a settings panel.

mainRepository.manage: Change which repositories the App reaches
mainRepository.installChoose: Returned from GitHub. This account reaches more than one installation of the Oxagen App, so pick the one this workspace should act through.
mainRepository.installNone: Returned from GitHub. The Oxagen App is not installed on any account you administer, so there is nothing to attach yet — install it on the account that owns the repository.

installations.heading: Installations this account reaches
installations.about: The App is already installed on these accounts. Pick the one this workspace should reach repositories through.
installations.loading: Listing the installations this account reaches…
installations.listLabel: GitHub accounts the App is installed on

failure.denied: Only an organization Owner or Admin can read or change this workspace's main repository.
failure.githubNotConnected: No GitHub App installation is attached to this workspace, so there is nothing to bind. Install the App first.
failure.repositoryNotInstalled: The installation cannot read that repository. Grant it access on GitHub, then try again.
failure.mainRepoBound: This workspace already binds a different main repository. Changing it is an org owner's decision, recorded as a security event.
failure.invalid: That repository name is not one GitHub accepts.
failure.pendingApproval: This needs a person to approve it. Request {accessRequestId} is waiting.
failure.unavailable: This could not be read from GitHub ({code}). Reopen this panel to try again.
failure.githubNotAuthorized: GitHub is not authorized for this organization yet, so there is nothing to list. Connect GitHub first.
failure.installationUnreachable: The connected GitHub account cannot reach that installation. Pick one it can, or install the App on that account.
